Our ApproachFlexibility-First Automation

Flexibility-First Automation is built for the reality of modern fulfillment — unpredictable, fast-moving, and always evolving. By unifying intelligent robots, real-time orchestration, and applied AI into one platform, we help you scale throughput, adapt to changes, and operate with confidence. Delivered through our Robots-as-a-Service model, you get immediate productivity gains and measurable savings from day one — with the flexibility to grow, adapt, and stay ahead of whatever comes next.

Collaborative Fulfillment

The Fastest, Most Flexible Path To Automation

With Locus Origin™ and Locus Vector™, associates stay focused on picking while robots handle the travel. This person-to-goods approach eliminates up to 90% of unproductive walking, driving 2-3x productivity gains, higher throughput, and ROI measured in months.

No fixed infrastructure. No operational disruption. Just a faster, more flexible way to automate fulfillment.

Key Workflows

  • Picking
  • Returns
  • Putaway
  • Sortation
  • Replenishment
  • Material Transport
Explore

Fully Autonomous Fulfillment

Near Lights Out Automation With Unparalleled Flexibility

With Locus Array™, robots pick and consolidate orders directly within the aisle. This robot-to-goods approach lowers labor costs by 90% while delivering higher throughput, greater accuracy, 24/7 operations, and up to 2x storage density.

Achieve near lights-out fulfillment without the rigidity, complexity, or CapEx of traditional automation.

Key Workflows

  • Picking
  • Putaway
  • Replenishment
  • Slotting
  • Auto Induct & Drop-off
  • Pick & Pass To Locus Cobots

Frequently Asked Questions

Locus Robotics helps the world’s leading brands automate fulfillment without sacrificing flexibility. By combining intelligent robots, AI-driven orchestration, and optimized workflows in one platform, we enable operators to increase throughput, adapt to changing business demands, and continuously improve performance across every workflow. Headquartered globally in Wilmington, Massachusetts, with regional headquarters in Amsterdam, Locus Robotics designs, builds, and deploys Physical AI systems that are transforming fulfillment around the world.

Most automation is built around fixed infrastructure. Locus Robotics is built around flexibility.
Our Flexibility-First Automation platform combines collaborative and fully autonomous robots, AI-driven orchestration, and optimized workflows in a single platform delivered through a Robots-as-a-Service model. That means you get all the benefits of automation but with faster deployment, minimal upfront investment, and ROI measured in months, not years.
Deploy our solutions in existing facilities with virtually no downtime or infrastructure changes, then scale and adapt as volumes, workflows, and business needs evolve. One platform. Every workflow. Unmatched flexibility.

LocusONE® is the intelligent software platform that acts as the central brain for the Locus Robotics fleet. It integrates directly with your existing Warehouse Management System (WMS) to dynamically route, manage, and orchestrate multiple types of autonomous robots in real time. By utilizing proprietary swarm AI, LocusONE® optimizes picking paths, tracks live facility performance, and coordinates tasks between humans and robots to maximize warehouse throughput.

Locus Robotics’ Robots-as-a-Service (RaaS) model eliminates the need for large upfront automation investments, allowing customers to deploy, scale, and optimize automation through a predictable operating expense. Every subscription includes continuous software innovation, ongoing operational optimization, maintenance, and 24/7 support, ensuring the system becomes more productive, capable, and valuable over time.

Locus Robotics can be deployed and fully operational in weeks, compared to traditional fixed automation systems that take months or years. Because our intelligent robots can navigate existing warehouse layouts without facility reconstruction or custom floor grids, there is zero structural downtime. Additionally, pre-built API connectors plug seamlessly into over 65+ Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) to drastically accelerate integration.
